transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you to see me?

Hi. Well... I guess what brings me in is that my head just feels really foggy lately. I work as a personal care aide, and I've been making these little mistakes in my client notes, or I'll just completely forget what I was about to do. It really isn't like me, so I figured I should come in and talk to someone about it.
Alongside this brain fog, how has your mood been feeling recently?

Honestly, it hasn't been great. Lately I've been waking up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. I mean, I can still get through my shift and talk to people just fine, but... inside, I just feel really sad and flat.
About how long have you been feeling this low and empty?
I'd say it's been about a month now. This low... kind of guilty, foggy feeling has just been hanging over me for the last four weeks or so.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before in your life, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

I don't really know. I mean... I guess I've had times where I felt a little down before, like anyone else, but I can't really remember it ever lasting this long or feeling quite this heavy. So, no, I don't think I've ever had a period exactly like this before.
Did something specific happen or change in your life around a month ago when these feelings started?

Well... now that I think about it, this whole shift really started after my uncle died. That was about two weeks ago. I might have been feeling a little off before then, which is why I was thinking a month, but his passing is when this really heavy feeling actually began.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in the things you usually enjoy doing?

Not really, no. I mean... I still do the things I usually like to do. I still watch my regular shows and read when I have the time. I just do them while feeling pretty down, I guess. But no, I haven't really lost interest in them.
How has your sleep been over the past couple of weeks?

It's been pretty all over the place, honestly. I either just lie there in bed thinking about all the family stuff, or I end up waking up way before my alarm goes off. And once I wake up like that, I can't really settle back down to get any more rest.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite recently?
No, not really. My appetite has been pretty normal, honestly. I'm still eating my regular meals just fine, so I haven't noticed any changes there.
How have your energy levels been over the past couple of weeks?

Honestly, my energy has been pretty low. Even on days when I don't really do much, my body just feels worn out. It's like... simple things, like helping a client shower at work or just carrying groceries inside, they just take a lot more out of me than they normally should.
During this time, have you had any thoughts of death, or thoughts of wanting to hurt yourself?

I'm not planning to hurt myself or anything like that. But... well, there have been some mornings lately where I just think it wouldn't be the worst thing if I just didn't wake up. And honestly, having thoughts like that... it scares me a bit.
